Sacubitril/valsartan reduces proteinuria depending on blood pressure in patients with stage 4-5 chronic kidney disease. Blood pressure (BP) control is an important factor in the management of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Several studies have shown that BP in many patients with CKD remained uncontrolled even with multiple medications.
